We had such a great experience at Veterinary Medical Center of Woodland Hills! We had been looking for a new veterinary center in the Woodland Hills and San Fernando Valley area, and we’re so happy we found this place. From the moment we contacted them, everyone was incredibly kind, friendly, and helpful, both over the phone and in person.
Dr. Analicia Rogel was wonderful with our dog. She was very professional, caring, and thorough during the examination. She took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of our questions, and gave us very helpful recommendations for the next steps. We really appreciated how much time and attention she gave us and how comfortable she made us feel.
We left feeling that our dog was truly in good hands, which means a lot to us as pet owners. We will definitely be coming back for the next exam, and we’re planning to bring our other two pups as well.
Thank you to Dr. Rogel and the entire team for such a positive experience. We’re very happy to have found our new veterinary center and highly recommend Veterinary Medical Center of Woodland Hills!

My pets, especially my chronically ill dog, have received nothing but exceptional care at the Veterinary Medical Center of Woodland Hills. The level of compassion, professionalism, and dedication shown by the entire team is truly outstanding.

Dr. Rogel is not only incredibly knowledgeable and skilled, but also genuinely caring and attentive. He takes the time to listen, answer questions, and ensure that we feel informed and supported every step of the way. Knowing that my dog has complex medical needs, it has been such a relief to have a veterinarian who is both thorough and compassionate.

When Dr. Rogel was away, Dr. Nina Nardi provided the same outstanding level of care. She was attentive, kind, and highly knowledgeable, and she made us feel completely confident that our dog was in excellent hands.

The entire staff deserves special recognition as well. Everyone is friendly, welcoming, and truly invested in the well-being of their patients. Whether it’s scheduling appointments, answering questions, or helping during stressful situations, they consistently go above and beyond. Despite their busy schedule, they always do their best to accommodate us, and we have never felt rushed or overlooked.

Finding a veterinary team you can fully trust is priceless, and we are incredibly grateful to have found one here. I would gladly give the Veterinary Medical Center of Woodland Hills 10 stars if I could. They have earned our trust, appreciation, and highest recommendation.

They are so kind and sweet and they make sure you understand all your options! they really are a great team❤️❤️❤️

We made a last minute appointment after our groomer informed us that our poodle had double ear infections. He is a swimming dog, so despite taking every precaution, ear infections do occasionally happen. We specifically scheduled this appointment because we needed a refill of the prescription ear drops that have successfully treated his infections for years.

Since we were traveling, my daughters took him to the appointment. They explained his history and requested the drops. Instead, the vet refused to prescribe them and insisted on a different treatment plan, telling us we would need to return in two weeks and only then might she consider prescribing the medication if the infection had not cleared.

When my daughters asked if I could speak with the vet directly, she refused and stated that I would be endangering my dog by overmedicating him. That accusation was both frustrating and unfounded. We have had dogs our entire lives and would never be comfortable overmedicating any pet. In fact, we only use these prescription drops when our regular drying agent is no longer effective and our dog is already showing symptoms of an ear infection. Because we use them sparingly and appropriately, a single prescription has often lasted us for years.

The main reason for this emergency appointment was to obtain medication that has consistently worked for our dog in the past. Instead, we left without it after unnecessary testing, additional expense, and a disappointing experience.

We ultimately contacted a mobile veterinarian, who reviewed the situation, prescribed the same drops without issue, and charged less than half of what we paid at this clinic.

Based on our experience, I would recommend exploring mobile or telehealth veterinary options before spending your time and money here.
